description: Get the calling org's monthly usage totals for the last 1-12 UTC calendar months (default 6), oldest first, ending with the current partial month. Each month lists every monthly counter (api_calls, events, webhook_deliveries, availability_queries, proposals, holds_created, holds_confirmed, holds_expired, cross_calendar_queries); limits are the current plan's (null = unlimited). Requires an Organization key (chr_sk_*); Agent keys cannot read org-wide usage.

months.description: Number of UTC calendar months to return, 1-12 (default 6)

name: get_usage_history
